summary_rationale: Garware Hi-Tech Films has structurally transformed from a 7–10% OPM commodity BOPET producer (FY15–FY18) into an 86% value-added specialty films franchise (73–75% Consumer Products: Sun Control, Architectural, and Paint Protection Films) generating 21%–28.7% operating margins, 10 consecutive years of positive Free Cash Flow, zero long-term debt, and ₹933 crore in cash and liquid investments as of September 2026. Chip-to-film vertical integration and the upcoming Q3 FY2027 Lubrizol-partnered TPU extrusion line provide a durable cost moat (54–60% gross margins vs. ~42–45% for asset-light peer XPEL). KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than unblemished PASS due to high US geographic concentration (45–51% of sales, demonstrated by the FY2026 tariff pause), ~30% single-customer concentration, and elevated inventory days (149 days in FY2026) from US buffer warehousing.
